About Ascendion
Ascendion is a leader in AI-Native platform driven software engineering company that underwrites outcomes, helping businesses innovate faster, smarter, and with greater impact. We partner with Global 2000 clients across North America, UK, Europe, and APAC to solve complex challenges in data, experience design, software product engineering, and workforce transformation. Powered by expert engineers, thousands of AI agents, and our Engineering to the Power of AI™ (EngineeringAI) method, we deliver measurable outcomes that build trust, unlock value, and accelerate growth. Learn more at ascendion.com


Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life
We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:
- Build the coolest tech for world's leading brands
- Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
- Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
- Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience


Experience a community of change makers! Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.


About the Role
We are looking for a AI Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data.


Job Title: AI Data Engineer


Key Responsibilities:


- Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or PySpark.
- Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
- Knowledge of data storage technologies such as Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Delta Lake.
- Familiarity with orchestration tools like Apache Airflow or Azure Data Factory.
- Understanding of machine learning workflows and MLOps concepts.
- Experience using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Preferred Skills Experience with Databricks.
- Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI frameworks.
- Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB).
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Knowledge of streaming technologies such as Kafka or Azure Event Hubs.
- Exposure to data governance and security best practices.


Minimum Qualifications:
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data.
- Build and optimize data pipelines for AI/ML and Generative AI applications.
- Prepare, clean, and transform datasets for machine learning model training and inference.
- Integrate AI/ML models into production environments and applications.
- Develop and maintain data lakes, data warehouses, and feature stores.
- Work with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) to deploy and manage data solutions.
- Implement data quality, governance, security, and monitoring practices.
- Optimize SQL queries and big data processing jobs for performance and scalability.
- Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Software Engineers to deliver AI-powered products.
- Create technical documentation and support CI/CD for data and AI pipelines.
- Required Skills Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
- Experience with ETL/ELT tools and data pipeline development.


Location: Pune


Want to change the world? Let us know. Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let's talk!
